## Checked

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Each commit is one conventional line (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] A bug fix has a test
- [ ] No secrets or personal data (`python3 dev/scan_secrets.py`)
- [ ] Idle RAM and CPU unchanged (or the cost is explained)
- [ ] New text is in `assets/locales/en_US.json`
